name: slice-planning
description: Break one approved milestone into small vertical slices.
---

# Slice Planning

Create one slice plan at a time. Each slice must contain: ID, user value, scope, prerequisites, exact expected files, API/data impact, implementation steps, tests, security/rights checks, rollback strategy, non-goals and measurable acceptance criteria.

Prefer a thin end-to-end vertical slice over broad incomplete layers. Limit the slice to a reviewable change. Do not implement. Request `APPROVE SLICE <ID>`.
